name: Denver Modern Showroom
old_description: Buy 3, Get 1 Free Stools & Dining Chairs · Buy 1, Get 1 50% Off Lounge Chairs & Rockers
about:
Denver Modern operates a showroom and e-commerce business from Denver, Colorado. The company's founding year is not publicly disclosed, nor are its ownership structure or founders identified in available sources. It presents itself as a purveyor of heirloom-quality modern furniture with a focus on sustainable practices.

The product lineup includes bar and counter stools, dining chairs and tables, lounge chairs, sofas, modular sectionals, outdoor furniture, bedroom pieces, and decor items such as rugs, lighting, and pillows. Many items are marketed as Denver Modern originals. The company also offers interior design services — both in-person at its Denver showroom and virtually — along with a trade program that provides exclusive pricing, dedicated support, and free material swatches to design professionals. Products are described as fully assembled upon delivery. No facility size, employee count, or production volumes are disclosed.

Denver Modern serves residential customers furnishing living rooms, dining areas, bedrooms, and outdoor spaces, as well as trade professionals including interior designers and architects. The trade program is positioned for specifiers seeking project pricing and support. The company does not list specific commercial or hospitality clients.

The brand differentiates itself through a sustainability narrative that includes carbon offsetting and the use of eco-friendly materials, a buy-more-save promotional model (buy three stools or dining chairs, get the fourth free; buy one lounge chair, get a second at half price), and a customer-experience emphasis highlighted by fully assembled delivery, a 30-day exchange window on non-custom items, and a commitment to responsive support.
